trigger.description: A snapshot read fence requests a historical workspace generation, but historical database and asset selection is unavailable. Refuse retrieval even without strict mode and even when the requested number matches the current generation.
setup_commands: # No setup is required; snapshot replay is unavailable for initialized and missing stores.

message_contains: requested workspace generation 7 cannot be replayed
expected_emission.repair_string: Historical workspace replay is unavailable. If current state is acceptable, retry with --read-fence latest --strict-read-fence; otherwise restore the required workspace snapshot before querying.
